subject.title: Feature: configurable mediaLocalRoots for image tool

question: Should configurable image/media local roots be solved as a unified filesystem-root policy, a narrow media-only allowlist, or not supported beyond managed/channel-scoped roots?
rationale: The request changes the host filesystem read boundary for model-facing media tools, and the safest shape depends on maintainer intent for config surface, `workspaceOnly` semantics, and the open `tools.fs.roots` direction.

options.title: Use one filesystem-root policy
options.body: Land or replace the broader `tools.fs.roots` direction so media tools, outbound media, and prompt images share one reviewed host-root contract.

options.title: Add media-only roots
options.body: Add a dedicated media-root field only if maintainers want image/PDF/media access to remain separate from general filesystem read policy.

options.title: Keep current boundaries
options.body: Keep only managed inbound media, workspace/default roots, and channel-scoped inbound roots, then document copy or workspace-link workflows.

recommendation.title: Use one filesystem-root policy
recommendation.body: Land or replace the broader `tools.fs.roots` direction so media tools, outbound media, and prompt images share one reviewed host-root contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged local-root policy work is the clearest current-main ownership signal for the central resolver and tests.
